notes.title: On Kickstarter - Latest Reine Works Title!
notes.content:
[url=http://kck.st/3kwp68q]Reine Works' latest otome game, "I Want to be an Idol!" is now live on Kickstarter! [/url]

[url=http://kck.st/3kwp68q][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/47be37ee793974bc8731e85c5229050c9967a3ed.png[/img][/url]

Itsuki Hayashibara's dream is to become an idol. Her parents' dream for her is to take over the dental practice. With one year to prove to them that she's a capable adult who can make good decisions, she sets out her comedic journey of growth. She might even find some romance along the way...!

"I Want to be an Idol" is a mix of stat-raiser and visual novel that allows you to create your own unique story for Itsuki. Explore Tokyo and forge deep relationships with those around you, or keep working hard towards your dream alone: the choice is in your hands!

We're presently working on getting the game's Steam page live, but in the meantime, make sure to check out our Kickstarter campaign!

Link: http://kck.st/3kwp68q

notes.title: Yuri Cyberpunk Thriller Synergia has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a long time coming, but we are proud to announce that Synergia is finally live! After 4 years, the game is finally out. Synergia is a unique cyberpunk yuri thriller, wrapped up in a neon artstyle.

One android's fate may spell the difference between peace, war, the blossoming of a new religion, or a technological singularity beyond comprehension.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047010/Synergia/

The game features over 100+ unique CGs & BGs, multiple endings, and up to an estimated 10+ hours of gameplay. Also includes steam achievements! The game will run a 10% discount for the week of its release.

notes.content:

As some of you have have noticed, new achievements recently popped up on the roster. We're happy to say that the corresponding update is now live! You can read the patch notes below;

notes.title: Kickstarter Live! Signed and Sealed With a Kiss

Check it out here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1367486473/signed-and-sealed-with-a-kiss-romance-visual-novel?

[h1]About the game[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/933230/Signed_and_Sealed_With_a_Kiss/

You get an unexpected package delivery one day. When you open it, there’s a man inside - but luckily, he comes with instructions! You have your own impressionable boyfriend. It’s your duty to shape him into a proper person… since he’s actually a “doll” with no past exposure to people. 

However, this delivery wasn’t meant for you. Will you fall in love with the person he turns out to be? Will you be able to keep him by your side?

[h1]Kickstarter Campaign[/h1]

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1367486473/signed-and-sealed-with-a-kiss-romance-visual-novel?

If you'd like to support the campaign without pledging, we'd appreciate any & all social media shares you can offer! Thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: Quick Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Quick bug fix as of today, 10/7, which adds more save pages (up to 5 now), as well as fixes the bug players had with saves/loads not working past the first page. Certain achievements should also be fixed now.

notes.title: Quick Fixes + Upcoming Content Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Reine Works has sent over a new build to us, which has the following fixes based on player feedback;
- Name switch in some parts of Mayu's route fixed
- Gallery achievement [i]should[/i] be fixed
- Auto-forward placed on what was previously the skip button - (one can still skip by holding CTRL)

They talked with us about an upcoming roadmap of features they're interested in implementing in game. Please note that we do not have a time frame in mind for most of these yet, as some things will depend on cumulative sales;

- toggle for R18 content when patch is installed + animation toggle
- Underwear toggle (forces underwear on each sprite)
- English VA 
- Japanese VA
- Russian TL 
- Digital dakimakura DLC 
- additional CG animations, especially for adult CGs in the patch

We hope you've been enjoying the game. Is there a feature you'd like to see? You can let us know if the comments below. 

On another note, it seems that Steam may have had errors sending out the wishlist notifications to those who had wishlisted the game. We were informed by some fans that they did not receive wishlist notification emails. As such, our visibility has been hurt a bit - if you're enjoying the game and feel kind, leaving reviews really helps out both us and the development team, especially as Steam continues to change their algorithms for visibility, compounded with unfortunate happenings such as this.

Thank you to everyone, we hope you've had fun with the game and will continue to.

notes.title: Game Release - Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're very happy to say that Our Lovely Escape has now been officially released. It's been a long journey, but thank you to everyone who stuck with us and has expressed interest in the game. We've updated the store page with new screenshots from the finalized build of the game too, since the page hasn't been updated since it's inception. The 10% discount will last a week from launch. 

There is also a free 18+ patch to restore 18+ content to the game. It features 6 CGs, and various scenes. Installing the patch will auto-install the content; there is no need to do anything else after the patch is installed. 
For those who need to install it manually (for whatever reason), it is as simple as dropping the patch.rpa" in the /game/ folder inside the game's directory.

There is also an artbook/guide DLC, which is $4.99. It features a bunch of pages with hi-res art, including concept art and promo sketches not seen in game! It also has a guide to every choice/route in game in it. 

Thank you again to everyone, we hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Upcoming Release Info + Screenshots!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have very good news for all the fans waiting for the game! Both the base game and (free) 18+ DLC will be releasing very soon, as they've both been approved by Valve for release. The 18+ DLC will be free as mentioned, and the base game will be $9.99. We will also be launching an additional artbook DLC at launch. 

So why haven't we released yet if we're already approved? Well, there's not much holding us back from release. We're just finishing up a few things, such as the artbook, and making sure the game is polished prior to release, such as the gallery working with the animated CGs in the 18+ DLC. As such we will have a release date very soon - we're estimated within the next 2 weeks or so, prior to just about the end of the month. We'll make announcements here for the release date at least a week in advance, and then a day in advance to the date as a reminder. Also, as a separate reminder, the game will be releasing in both English & Simplified Chinese! Thank you to our friends at Quality Arts Games for helping with the Chinese translation.

notes.title: Update on Release - Game coming next month (ENG + CHN) / 发售日期更新——游戏将于下月发售（英文+简体中文
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We apologize for scarce communication regarding the game's progress. Development has been hectic for the developers, as illness and other factors have played detrimental rolls to an otherwise timely schedule. This has resulted in a significant silence on both of our parts.

However, we are happy to see we've gotten back in more consistent touch with the developer as of recently, and after talking with them, we are both confident in a final release date of [b]next month, September 2019[/b]. We are still finding out a specific date in the month, but are currently aiming for mid September, around the 2nd week or so. The game will release in both [b]English & Simplified Chinese,[/b]

Thank you all for your patience and continued interest, we hope you'll all enjoy the game upon release!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

大家好

我们就游戏开发进程汇报的缺失向广大玩家们表示道歉。开发进程以及最终发售日期受到了开发者的患病以及其他因素的很大影响。这导致了我们在此前不得不保持沉默。

但是最近我们重新与开发者取得了联系，在商讨过后，我们都有信心确定游戏能在下个月，即2019年9月发售。我们仍在探讨具体的日期，但是初步估计会在9月中旬发售，游戏在发售时将提供英文与简体中文两种语言的支持。

谢谢玩家们的耐心，我们希望你们能在发售后享受这款游戏！

SYNOPSIS:
There's another side to each person, one that we cannot see without help. There are those who seek out said help, each earnestly wishing to find their true selves. It is then that they seek out the one known as the "Magic Mirror," a revered sorceress of recent legend.

Watch as the darkness lifts in the hearts of those who seek out the Magic Mirror. Follow Reina and experience nine short and sweet tales of romance, friendship, and unrequited love.

FEATURES:
[list]
[*] Four GxB routes
[*] Four GxG routes
[*] One secret, unlock-able route
[*] 150,000+ words
[*] 19 endings
[*] Original theme song by harmonicblend
[*] 40+ unique CGs
[*] Two interchangeable sprite sets
[*] Partial voice acting with talents from “The Ancient Magus' Bride”, “Yandere Simulator”, and more
[/list]
